title: Murder on the Melusine
question: Who killed Oskar Brandt?

clues.label: Brandt's treasure
clues.words: Oskar Brandt's treasure: a lost Strauss waltz, going to experts in Vienna tomorrow.

clues.label: Clara
clues.words: Clara, his niece and heir, plays tonight's concert.

clues.label: Dr Fehr
clues.words: Dr Fehr, the ship's doctor, gave Brandt his sleeping drops.

clues.label: Margit
clues.words: Margit, a dealer, swore she'd have the waltz at any price.

clues.label: Professor Duval
clues.words: Professor Duval, the old friend who found the waltz, says he sat in the front row all concert.

clues.label: The cabin at dawn
clues.words: 7 am: Brandt is found poisoned, and the waltz is gone.

clues.label: The pocket watch
clues.words: Under his hand: his watch, stopped at 9:45.

clues.label: The medicine bottle
clues.words: The doctor's sleeping drops, every last one in the pot.

clues.label: The new will
clues.words: Unsigned, it would have left Clara nothing.

clues.label: The doctor's night
clues.words: 10:25: Dr Fehr is tending a seasick passenger.

clues.label: Margit ashore
clues.words: 10:25: Margit is still ashore, over a glass of wine.

clues.label: A scrap of the waltz
clues.words: Strauss's ink would be brown with age.

clues.label: The concert photo
clues.words: A passenger's snapshot of the concert.

verdict.gold: Professor Duval did it, and the photo proves it.
verdict.solved: Professor Duval did it. The concert photo proves it best.
verdict.wrongProof: Professor Duval did it, but that picture doesn't prove it.

explanation.text: The watch was staged: at 10:25 Brandt was alive, his guest already inside.
At 10:25 Clara was on stage, the doctor at a bunk, Margit ashore.
Duval's front-row chair was empty, his scarf on it.
The waltz was his forgery: fresh green ink, like his pen.
